should_fail: tests/features.py: the _confidence_margins block (~23988-24030) checks the fresh-install None, the cap and the trust damping, but never a damp inside (0, 1e-9] with sigma > 1 C; it lacks an assertion that a near-perfect trust returns None. tests/config_flow_steps.py executes the line without asserting on it.

finding.title: No check feeds _confidence_margins a damping in (0, 1e-9]; removing its early None is unseen
finding.claim: _confidence_margins returns None (the byte-inert no-margin answer) when 1 - trust() <= 1e-9. With that guard removed, a temperature MAE a hair above 0.25 C (damp ~1e-9) and a lead sigma above 1 C yield an array of ~2e-9 C margins instead of None. The full gate does not notice; the consequence is a non-None min_temp_margins handed to the solver with nanokelvin values.
